reply: It started yesterday morning, so about a day and a half ago. It really stings and burns, especially right at the end, just like my last one. reply: No, I haven't had any fevers or shivers and I feel fine apart from this. I don't have any pain in my back, just a bit of an ache low down in my tummy. I am eating normally and haven't been sick.

utterance: No worries if you'd rather skip that test today — it's entirely optional, and you can ask for it any time. To wrap up: take the trimethoprim once a day for the three days, drink plenty of fluids, and Ural sachets from the pharmacy can ease the sting. I expect you to feel much better within 24 to 48 hours. Please come back straight away — or see a doctor sooner — if you develop a fever, shivers, pain in your back or side, vomiting, if the symptoms get worse, or if things haven't settled within a couple of days of finishing the tablets. Any questions before you go?
